entry.title: Welcome — What I’ll Be Posting Here
entry.content:
Welcome! 👋
I’m Dominik (aka Domiko7 on GitHub), and this blog is where I’ll be sharing what I build, learn, and explore.

🌍 Seismology​

One of my main interests is seismology and earthquakes. I work with real-time seismic data, monitoring tools, and earthquake early-warning concepts.
Here, I’ll post things like:

  • Seismic data analysis
  • Earthquake monitoring projects
  • Visualizations and real-time feeds
  • Experiments and ideas related to EEW systems

💻 Technology & Programming​

Most of my work revolves around coding and tech projects, many of which are open source on GitHub. Expect posts about:

  • Python projects and scripts
  • Real-time data pipelines
  • Embedded systems (ESP32, Raspberry Pi, sensors)
  • Lessons learned while building and breaking things

🔍 Analysis & Project Breakdowns​

I’ll also write analysis-style posts, where I break down:

  • How a project works internally
  • Design decisions and tradeoffs
  • Performance, reliability, and improvements
  • What went wrong (and how I fixed it)

📦 Other Topics​

Sometimes I’ll post about things that don’t fit neatly into one category — aviation, experiments, random ideas, or updates on ongoing projects.

This blog is mainly a logbook of learning and building.
If you’re into earthquakes, data, software, or just seeing how projects evolve over time — you’re in the right place.

Thanks for stopping by 🙂
